title: China Employment Watch
description: Track China’s labour market through official releases, historical coverage and experimental indicators.

dashboard.failure: Collection failed. The last verified snapshot is shown.
dashboard.invalid: Quality checks failed. The last verified snapshot is shown.
dashboard.official_explainer: Official monthly rates for urban China and for 31 major cities.
dashboard.pmi_explainer: Monthly survey measures for manufacturing and non-manufacturing. The reference line at 50 marks no change.
dashboard.index_explainer: Equal-weight average of the two PMI employment signals on a fixed robust scale. Experimental.
dashboard.unusual: Unusual changes flagged in the dataset
dashboard.method_baseline: The experimental demand index uses January 2023 through December 2024 as its frozen baseline. Each monthly PMI component is centered by its median and divided by 1.4826 × MAD before equal-weight averaging. Component scores are capped at ±5.
dashboard.method_shadow: The shadow index requires both comparable search data and the demand index for the same period. Official unemployment is an independent reference. Exam-search indicators are separate.
dashboard.method_validation: The PMI comparison uses rolling time-ordered validation. The shadow index lacks eligible test cases.
